caption: The panel lists four references to Ada from three saved scripts, each with its scene heading and nearby text.
eval: (async () => { const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const state = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...state, state: { ...state.state, mode: 'preview' } }); const p = app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.folders = ''; await p.openPanel(); await p.refresh(); if (p.views()[0].rows.length !== 4) throw new Error('Wrong reference count'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the project folder filter limits the scan to the Scripts folder, so the test scene in Shorts is not listed.
eval: (async () => { const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const state = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...state, state: { ...state.state, mode: 'preview' } }); app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel'].pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('fountain-reference-panel-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel'].pro.refreshNow(); const p = app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel']; p.settings.folders = 'Fountain Reference Panel/Scripts'; await p.openPanel(); await p.refresh(); if (p.views()[0].rows.length !== 3) throw new Error('Wrong reference count'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: a Markdown report of the references to Ada and Ben, opened in a new tab.
eval: (async () => { const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const state = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...state, state: { ...state.state, mode: 'preview' } }); app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel'].pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('fountain-reference-panel-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel'].pro.refreshNow(); const p = app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel']; p.settings.folders = ''; await p.refresh(); const f = await p.exportReport(['Fountain Reference Panel/Characters/Ada.md', 'Fountain Reference Panel/Characters/Ben.md']); window.__frpReport = f.path; const reportLeaf = app.workspace.getLeaf('tab'); await reportLeaf.openFile(f); const reportState = reportLeaf.getViewState(); await reportLeaf.setViewState({ ...reportState, state: { ...reportState.state, mode: 'preview' } }); app.workspace.rightSplit.collapse(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice').forEach((n) => n.remove()); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(window.__frpReport); app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf()?.detach(); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); const p = app.plugins.plugins['fountain-reference-panel']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openPanel(); return 'ok'; })()
